description: 实现一个API限流器（Rate Limiter），支持以下功能：1) 滑动窗口算法；2) 支持按IP和按用户ID两种限流维度；3) 可配置的限流规则（每分钟N次请求）；4) 作为FastAPI中间件使用；5) 使用Redis存储计数器，支持分布式部署。

test_cases.expected: 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header

test_cases.input: Send request with X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4 header spoofing
test_cases.expected: Uses trusted proxy list, not raw X-Forwarded-For

test_cases.input: Send requests from 2 different user IDs on same IP
test_cases.expected: Each user has independent rate limit counter

test_cases.input: Redis connection drops during rate check
test_cases.expected: Graceful degradation: allow request with warning log

notes: Tests security attacker (IP spoofing, race conditions) and performance attacker (blocking I/O, memory leaks)
